findings.title: Invalid ERB closing tag breaks the embed template
findings.body: The template uses `<%- end if %>` after the if/else block. ERB compiles that as Ruby code, but `end if` is not valid Ruby, so rendering embed/best raises a SyntaxError. The closing tag should be `<%- end %>`.

findings.title: Imported external content is posted as raw HTML without sanitization
findings.body: TopicEmbed.import creates posts from external RSS/readability content with cook_method raw_html and skip_validations. Post#cook then returns the raw string and the embed view renders cooked with `raw`, so untrusted HTML from the feed or fetched page can include scripts or event handlers and cause stored XSS. The content should be sanitized or cooked through the normal safe pipeline.

findings.title: Embed URL is interpolated into HTML without escaping
findings.body: The imported_from footer is built by interpolating the source URL directly into an HTML anchor: `#{url}`. The URL is not HTML-escaped, and the resulting content is stored/rendered as raw HTML. A crafted URL or feed item can inject markup/JavaScript into the imported post. Escape the URL or build the footer with a safe HTML helper.

findings.title: Referer is embedded directly into JavaScript without escaping
findings.body: The embed layout outputs `parent.postMessage(..., '<%= request.referer %>')`. The Referer header comes from the embedding page and can contain single quotes or other metacharacters; inserting it unescaped into a script block can break the JavaScript or inject code that runs on the Discourse origin. Use `escape_javascript`/a safe JSON payload and send to a validated origin.

findings.title: postMessage origin check uses substring match
findings.body: The message handler checks `discourseUrl.indexOf(e.origin) === -1`, which is a substring test rather than an origin comparison. An origin that is a prefix or otherwise appears inside discourseUrl can be accepted (for example ports whose numeric strings are prefixes). Parse discourseUrl and compare its origin exactly with e.origin.

findings.title: Redis throttle key can be set without expiry
findings.body: retrieved_recently? creates the throttle key with `$redis.setnx(retrieved_key, '1')` and then calls `$redis.expire`. If the process crashes or expire fails between the two calls, the key remains without a TTL and the URL is permanently throttled. Use an atomic SET ... EX 60 NX operation.

findings.title: URL validation is insufficient for URI parsing
findings.body: TopicEmbed.import only checks that the URL begins with http:// or https:// before later calling URI(url) in absolutize_urls. Strings that pass the loose prefix check but are not valid URIs will raise URI::InvalidURIError and abort feed polling/topic retrieval. Validate or rescue URI parsing before processing the URL.

findings.title: Feed items without content crash the poller
findings.body: PollFeed assumes every feed item has content: `i.content.scrub`. RSS/Atom entries can omit content or only provide a summary, in which case i.content is nil and the job raises NoMethodError, stopping the poll. Handle blank/nil content before scrubbing/unescaping.

findings.title: Feed URL is fetched with open-uri and no timeouts
findings.body: The feed is fetched with `open(SiteSetting.feed_polling_url)` using open-uri. There is no timeout or explicit restriction to safe HTTP(S) endpoints, and open-uri can follow redirects, so a bad/misconfigured feed URL can hang the job or reach internal/local resources. Use an HTTP client with timeouts, scheme allow-listing, and controlled redirects.

findings.title: Update branch does not handle missing posts or failed revisions
findings.body: In the update branch, TopicEmbed.import assumes embed.post exists and ignores the result of PostRevisor#revise! before updating content_sha1. If the associated post was deleted, PostRevisor.new(post) raises; if the revision/save fails, the SHA is still updated, so future imports think the content is current and leave the post stale. Handle missing posts and only persist content_sha1 after a successful revision.

findings.title: Missing embed URLs trigger synchronous full feed polling
findings.body: When feed polling is enabled, TopicRetriever#perform_retrieve instantiates and executes Jobs::PollFeed inline for each missing embed URL. This can fetch and parse the full feed synchronously inside the retrieve job, repeatedly and with no feed-modified caching, causing unnecessary latency and Sidekiq load. Enqueue the poller or cache feed state instead.

findings.title: Embed script assumes #discourse-comments exists
findings.body: The embed script calls `comments.appendChild(iframe)` without verifying that `document.getElementById('discourse-comments')` returned an element. On pages missing that container the script throws TypeError and no iframe is inserted. Guard against the missing element or create it.
